rubric: A reply's second move follows from its first ("I'm from Washington. What about you?", never "I'm from Washington. Have you talked to Omar?").

03qnynxpjek.why: 'You're right to ask again' answers an ask, but the donor just made a threat, so the reply responds to a line that was not said.

0tckfjjdc6m.why: A cheery 'say hello to everyone at the employer' ignores the donor's threat and reads as if nothing hostile was said, so the exit does not answer it.
